mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_follow ( id, follower_uid, following_uid, is_active, created_at ) VALUES ( user_follow_seq.NEXTVAL, #{followerUid}, #{followingUid}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT u.uuid, u.name, u.nickname, u.address, u.address_detail AS addressDetail, u.zipcode, u.bio, u.profile_url AS profileUrl, u.birth_date AS birthDate FROM user_follow f JOIN user_info u ON f.follower_uid = u.uuid WHERE f.following_uid = #{userUid} AND f.is_active = 'Y'
